title: Repoise real-agent replay evidence (import format v1)
description: Machine-readable import format for real agent replay evidence (master plan section 11). Only directly measured quantities are accepted: every numeric field must come from an actual recorded run. Derived values (token savings, efficiency ratios, estimates) are forbidden: unknown properties are rejected at every level, so a fabricated or inferred field fails validation. The full task x condition matrix is required so results cannot be cherry-picked. Model names, task ids, revision and budgets are fixed for the whole run. Private pilot content stays out of this file: task entries carry only an id and the correctness criteria, never transcripts or repository payloads. Validation is implemented in scripts/eval/replay.mjs (no external schema engine dependency).

schemaVersion.description: Import format version. Must be 1 for this build.

runId.description: Stable identifier of the recorded replay run.

recordedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the run was recorded.

operator.description: Who recorded the run (name or handle).

fixed.description: Settings held constant across every task and condition of the run.

revision.description: Exact model revision/identifier used for all runs.

tasks.description: The fixed task set. Criteria only; never task transcripts.

correctnessCriteria.description: How task correctness was judged (deterministic checks, tests, review).

revision.description: Exact corpus revision the agent ran against (opaque, adapter-qualified).

budgets.description: Context/retrieval budgets fixed for the run.

promptVersion.description: Identifier of the fixed agent prompt/system-instruction version.

conditions.description: Comparison conditions actually run in this evidence file (declared subset of the full matrix; every declared condition must have every task).

runs.description: One entry per measured (task, condition) run; the complete declared matrix is required.

condition.description: Condition from the declared conditions list.

sampleSize.description: Number of repeated runs this entry aggregates (report sample size and uncertainty).

modelInputTokens.description: Measured total model input tokens for the task under this condition.

retrievalOutputTokens.description: Measured retrieval output tokens returned by search/read operations (engine-reported, estimated token counts).

toolCalls.description: Measured count of agent tool calls.

elapsedMs.description: Measured wall-clock elapsed time in milliseconds.

taskCorrect.description: Measured task correctness per the declared criteria.

retrievalErrors.description: Measured count of failed retrieval operations.
